title: Finite localization coordinates preserve shifted equal-degree fractions
statement: Let A be a commutative N-graded ring with grading 𝒜, r a natural number, a:Fin r→Z, and f any element of A. The additive A-linear map awayPi from Away f (Fin r→A) to Fin r→Away f A sends y/s to its coordinate fractions y_i/s. This map is bijective. A vector fraction belongs to degreeZeroFractions [def-sc-degree-zero-module-fractions] for the grading in which y has degree n precisely when every y_i lies in 𝒜_(a_i+n) (or is zero if a_i+n<0) if and only if each coordinate fraction belongs to the corresponding individual shifted degreeZeroFractions. This includes the empty product and zero denominators.

source.place: Finite direct sum consequence of Tag 01M7 (2); equal-degree localization of Algebra Section 00JM; finite products via Mathlib IsLocalizedModule.pi

proof.text: Define awayPi using IsLocalizedModule.map on the coordinate projections. Its value on y/s is y_i/s by map_LocalizedModules. Localization.pi identifies the product of localized modules as a localization of the product. Its universal equivalence agrees with awayPi on y/1; linearMap_ext gives equality and hence bijectivity. Induction on a vector fraction and on a ring fraction proves compatibility with localized scalars by mk_smul_mk.

A homogeneous vector representative projects to an equal-degree coordinate representative. Conversely choose (d_i,y_i,s_i) representing every coordinate, with s_i homogeneous of degree d_i. Let t=product s_i and D=sum d_i. Multiply y_i by the product u_i of all s_j with j unequal to i. The multiplier is homogeneous of degree D-d_i, so z_i=u_i*y_i has shifted degree D whenever a_i+d_i is nonnegative. Otherwise y_i and z_i are zero and meet the shifted degree condition regardless of the sign of a_i+D. The denominator t has degree D. The common-factor cancellation lemma gives z_i/t=y_i/s_i. Injectivity of awayPi identifies z/t with the original fraction. This proof uses no nonzero denominator assumption. Empty products and sums produce t=1 and D=0.

lean.statement:
theorem awayPi_bijective_degreeZero
    {A σ : Type v} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → ℤ)
    (f : A) :
    Function.Bijective (awayPi r f) ∧
    ∀ x : LocalizedModule.Away f (Fin r → A),
      x ∈ degreeZeroFractions (fun n : ℕ ↦ (𝒜 n : Set A))
        (fun n : ℕ ↦ {y : Fin r → A | ∀ i,
          if 0 ≤ a i + n then y i ∈ 𝒜 (a i + n).toNat else y i = 0})
        (Submonoid.powers f) ↔
      ∀ i, awayPi r f x i ∈ degreeZeroFractions
        (fun n : ℕ ↦ (𝒜 n : Set A))
        (fun n : ℕ ↦ {y : A |
          if 0 ≤ a i + n then y ∈ 𝒜 (a i + n).toNat else y = 0})
        (Submonoid.powers f)
